components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Indigo background, white text, 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6366f1; color: #fff; border: none; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4f46e5; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #ccc; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content card. White background, 12px radius, soft shadow.
components.html: 🎯 当前核心目标
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-card-label { font-size: 14px; color: #888; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #333; }

components.name: Hero Card
components.description: Gradient hero card for dashboard greeting and check-in. White text on purple gradient.
components.css: .ds-hero-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%); border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px; color: #fff; } .ds-hero-greeting { font-size: 15px; opacity: 0.9; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-hero-stat { font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input. White background, gray border, indigo focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 16px; outline: none; background: #fff; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #6366f1; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Fixed bottom tab bar with emoji icons and labels.
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: #fff; display: flex; justify-content: space-around; padding: 12px 0; box-shadow: 0 -2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-nav-item { text-decoration: none; color: #666; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav-active { color: #6366f1; } .ds-nav-icon { font-size: 20px; }

components.name: User Chat Bubble
components.description: Right-aligned user message bubble. Indigo background, white text.
components.html: 今天的学习计划是什么？
components.css: .ds-bubble-user-wrap { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 0 8px; } .ds-bubble-user { max-width: 80%; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 16px 16px 4px 16px; background: #6366f1; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }

components.name: AI Chat Bubble
components.description: Left-aligned AI message bubble. Cloud background, dark text.
components.html: 建议你先复习高数第三章，然后做两篇阅读理解。
components.css: .ds-bubble-ai-wrap { display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; padding: 0 8px; } .ds-bubble-ai { max-width: 80%; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 16px 16px 16px 4px; background: #f0f0f0; color: #333; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }

narrative.overview:
This is a companion, not a tool. The interface should feel like opening a well-organized notebook that also happens to cheer you on. Every surface is clean and uncluttered, but never cold: emoji accents, gentle gradients, and warm feedback make it feel like a friend who's tracking progress alongside you.

The system rejects corporate productivity software, rejects complexity for its own sake, and rejects visual monotony. It embraces color as emotion: purple for primary actions signals ambition; amber/orange for streaks and check-ins signals warmth; green for completion signals satisfaction.
keyCharacteristics: Gradient accents reserved for hero moments
Bottom navigation for mobile-first thumb reach

rules.name: The Gradient Restraint Rule
rules.body: Gradients appear on exactly three surfaces: login background, dashboard greeting card, and check-in hero. Everywhere else, flat color.

rules.name: The Emoji-as-Icon Rule
rules.body: The project uses emoji in place of icon libraries for navigation, section headers, and feedback. This is a deliberate personality choice.

rules.name: The No-Decorative-Type Rule
rules.body: The system uses exactly one font family (system-ui). No serif display fonts, no monospace for stats. Personality is carried by emoji, color, and layout.

rules.name: The One-Shadow-Per-Element Rule
rules.body: Every element gets exactly one shadow treatment. Never combine box-shadow with border for the same decorative purpose.

dos: Use emoji liberally in navigation, section headers, and empty states
Keep shadows consistent: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) for cards
Use indigo (#6366f1) as the single primary accent
Reserve gradients for hero moments only
Ensure touch targets are at least 44px
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right as colored accent stripes
Don't use border-radius above 16px on cards
Don't mix shadow and border on the same element decoratively
Don't add a second font family
Don't use more than 3 different font sizes on a single screen
Don't add dark mode without redesigning the gradient and color system
